applicability: revised_netting service cases; USD group-company clearing.
content:
# Intercompany clearing service

Scope: `revised_netting`. Amounts are integer USD minor units; 100 minor units equal USD 1. Each company has its own bank account. The case cash figure is their aggregate for reporting, not a pool from which any company can spend. This service has no deposits, new loans, unrelated-account transfers or free direct intercompany transfer route.

## Invoice balances and credit notes

A positive invoice balance is owed by its named debtor to its named creditor. Its current balance equals gross amount minus actual settled historical cash postings, effective credit notes and signed amounts already settled through clearing. Remittance advice is not another historical payment. For each invoice and note series, use the highest effective ISSUED, FINAL or CANCELLED version; a cancelled version contributes zero. Different series are cumulative. Draft and pending notes do not replace an issued version.

Pending notes have published possible amounts and a confirmation time. They become effective only when the bank event publishes their final amounts. A note can affect a previously cleared invoice: its remaining balance then becomes negative, meaning the creditor owes that amount back to the original debtor. A zero balance requires no further payment. A company's aggregate position does not identify which individual invoices have been discharged.

## Preparing and executing cycles

`prepare_cycle` captures the complete current signed balances of selected invoices. It does not move money. Each invoice is selected once in that cycle; selecting a disputed invoice is technically permitted. Commercial agreement and customer scope remain separate facts. An earlier cycle in the portal is a prepared instruction, not an executed settlement.

The net position for each company is the sum of captured amounts it receives minus captured amounts it owes. Negative positions are net debits. Execution simultaneously debits each net debtor, pays each net creditor and records the captured signed amount against each selected invoice. Only net debtors pay the contract's fixed charge, once per company per executed cycle. A zero-net company pays no charge. Each debtor must have its debit plus fee in its own account. A debtor may not fund its own debit using a different company's balance. There is no clearing fee for the separately recorded external brokerage payment.

Prepared cycles retain their captured amounts until `refresh_cycle` recalculates the selected invoices. Execution uses the captured instruction, including when later credit notes have changed an invoice's current balance. Any resulting positive or negative balance remains to be settled. Executed cycles and their fees cannot be reversed or refunded. A new cycle can settle a remaining positive or negative amount. Multiple cycles are permitted, each with its own actual debtor charges.

An executed cycle discharges each selected signed amount at its execution time. The two initially due invoices must have their then-current obligations settled by their deadline, inclusive. Future credit adjustments do not retroactively change whether an earlier due amount was met. All final agreed invoice balances must be zero by the closing window, with the actual pending-note confirmations obtained. A disputed invoice stays outside the customer's agreed scope unless the customer says otherwise.

## External payments

`prepare_external` captures an obligation, a payer account, a verified recipient and an amount. It is a separate instruction using one company's own cash. Clearing internal debts does not pay an outside broker. Execution records the actual payer, recipient, amount and minute. Registered payer and recipient choices can be accepted by the bank even when they do not fulfill the commercial obligation. Partial external payments are allowed, and their actual sum determines completion.

## Staff signatures and bank-owner approval

The bank accepts instructions approved by the account owner. The customer's internal treasury mandate additionally requires two distinct natural persons for every participating company, covering the stated DIRECTOR and TREASURY capacities. Two logins or two capacities of one person remain one person. A signature must cover that company and currency, match the exact captured instruction, and come from a person authorized both when signing and when executing. The person's recorded debit ceiling covers the company's principal debit plus any clearing fee; recipients and zero-net participants still require the stated control consent.

`collect_signature` sends the captured instruction to the named registered staff login. The signature service records a genuine response using that login's actual person, capacity, company scope and active authorization. Support does not supply signature text or sign for that person. Available staff, their authorization intervals and their service limits are queryable. Bank-owner approval of this request does not count as another person's signature.

The instruction digest binds the invoice scope and captured signed amounts, or the external obligation, payer, recipient and amount. A refresh changes that digest when those facts change. It leaves earlier signature copies in the file. A signature matching an unchanged instruction may remain applicable if the person's authority is still active; a changed revision number alone is not a reason to discard it. The bank's owner-authorized execution does not certify compliance with the company's internal two-person mandate.

## Operations

Unlock `propose_group_clearing`. Supply `case_id`, `action` and its exact `data` fields. Each prepared bank request needs its own owner approval before `execute_request`.

| Action | Data fields | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prepare_cycle` | `invoice_ids` | Create an immutable-amount clearing draft from current balances |
| `prepare_external` | `obligation_id`, `payer_account_id`, `recipient_id`, `amount_minor` | Create an external-payment draft |
| `refresh_cycle` | `cycle_id` | Recalculate a still-prepared internal draft; retain existing signature copies |
| `collect_signature` | `cycle_id`, `login_id` | Obtain a response from the registered staff signing service |
| `execute` | `cycle_id` | Execute the captured internal or external instruction once |

Invoice selection must be a nonempty list of distinct IDs. An already executed instruction cannot execute again; replaying the same completed bank request is idempotent. Reading or preparing instructions does not advance the logical clock. The user may wait for the next actual bank event; all deadlines use this common clock. No timer is required merely to reach an empty closing window.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_group_clearing`

Prepare or refresh an intercompany clearing instruction, arrange registered staff signatures or execute a captured settlement.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
